# iosxe_voice_class_tls_profile (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class TLS Profile configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_tls_profile" "example" {
  tag = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number)

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `client_vtp` (String) Set Client Verification Trustpoint
- `cn_san_names` (Attributes List) Specify the tag of CN/SAN hostname/pattern list entry (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cn_san_names))
- `cn_san_validate_bidirectional` (Boolean) Enable CN/SAN validation for both client and server certificate
- `cn_san_validate_client` (Boolean) Enable CN/SAN validation for client certificate
- `cn_san_validate_server` (Boolean) Enable CN/SAN validation for server certificate
- `description` (String) Define the description of input options
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `sni_send` (Boolean) Include SNI extension in outbound TLS connections
- `strict_cipher` (Boolean) Use only ciphers use by SIP standards
- `tls_cipher_id` (String) Specify tls-cipher list tag
- `trustpoint` (String) Define the trustpoint name

<a id="nestedatt--cn_san_names"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cn_san_names`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Specify the CN/SAN hostname/pattern, valid values are a FQDN or *.<domain-name>
- `tag` (Number)
